periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Began behavioral health screening at the Community Health Center and Public Health clinics and referred 238 residents. Set up a referral log so staff can follow each case. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Coastal Behavioral Health.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Extend screening to Bayview Medical Center discharge planning and design a warm-handoff line.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Bayview Medical Center discharge planners started screening, and referrals reached 341. Designed a warm-handoff line staffed by Public Health nurses who book the first appointment. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Coastal Behavioral Health, Bayview Medical Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add screening questions to WIC and clinic visits and open the warm-handoff line.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Screened and referred 462 residents, up 35% from Q2, after adding the screening questions to WIC and clinic visits. Started a warm-handoff line staffed by Public Health nurses who schedule the first appointment before the resident leaves. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Coastal Behavioral Health, Bayview Medical Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Track how many referrals result in a completed first visit, and extend warm handoffs to the Bayfront school-based health center.
